title: Unresponsive system & black screen after returning from suspend
body: Every time I return from suspend/hibernation in Xorg I get unresponsive black screen. TTY (ctrl+alt+FN) switching doesn't work. SysRq works, so to recover from freezes I do ctrl+prtsc+e and then ctrl+alt+del. This started happening after I upgraded the kernel to version 7.2.6. Initially I downgraded to 7.2.4, fixing the issue. Recently I've decided to tackle this again and, after tweaking all kinds of settings I could find, ended up with no solution, except that downgrading now doesn't help either. Hardware specs from neofetch: Host: Pulse GL76 11UEK REV:1.0 CPU: 11th Gen Intel i7-11800H (16) @ 4.600GHz GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Mobile / Max-Q GPU: Intel TigerLake-H GT1 [UHD Graphics] I use bspwm + sxhkd. I start Xorg from the TTY using startx (rootless). Tried nvidia-dkms, no luck (I didn't forget to install the right linux-headers when downgrading the kernel). Tried LTS kernel - same thing. /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf: # options nvidia NVreg_EnableS0ixPowerManagement=1 options nvidia NVreg_PreserveVideoMemoryAllocations=1 # options nvidia NVreg_EnableMSAuthorization=0 # options nvidia-drm modeset=1 options nvidia NVreg_TemporaryFilePath=/var/tmp Kernel arguments in /etc/default/grub: GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="resume=LABEL=ArchSwap loglevel=3 sysrq_always_enabled=1 acpi_osi=! \"acpi_osi=Windows 2015\"" I tried enabling and disabling these 3: nvidia-suspend, nvidia-hibernate, nvidia-resume. nvidia-persistenced.service, whatever that is, is disabled. Config produced by running nvidia-xconfig makes Xorg freeze on startup before even displaying the GUI (My TTY freezes with startx's initial stdout visible). However, my sxhkd xorg closure shortcut works. I tried putting the following in /etc/systemd/system/systemd-suspend.service.d/disable-freeze.conf: [Service] Environment="SYSTEMD_SLEEP_FREEZE_USER_SESSIONS=false" Output of cat .local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log | grep -E "(\(EE\)|\(WW\))" is: (WW) warning, (EE) error, (NI) not implemented, (??) unknown.
